definitions.components: Four-connected periodic regions of cells with density >= 0.35 and size >= 4. Tiny regions are counted separately; regions are not organisms.
definitions.neighborContrast: Mean absolute density difference over the 8192 unique periodic east/south edges.
definitions.blockedEdgeFraction: Fraction of the same 8192 edges blocked for biomass transport by current wall values; nutrient transport is never blocked.
definitions.sampledChange: Mean absolute density change and active-mask flip fraction from the previous census. Extinction can close an interval shorter than 100 ticks.
definitions.comparisonTick: Shared scheduled age for the experiment. It advances after extinction while physical fieldTick and all fields remain frozen.
definitions.accounting: Open density balance: expected = initial + reaction + diffusion residual + signed clamp adjustment - floor loss. This verifies bookkeeping, not reaction correctness or conservation of the open system.
definitions.interpretation: Density and nutrient are proxies in an engineered open-energy field toy. Walls are supplied reinforcement; this is not evidence of organisms, heredity, adaptation, or evolution.
